record.oneLiner: A Chinese sauropod with an extraordinarily long neck.
record.description: Mamenchisaurus was a sauropod of Jurassic China famous for its extraordinarily long neck — nearly half its total body length. Species ranged from roughly 15 to 26 m long, possibly up to 35 m.

notableFacts.text: Its neck made up nearly half its total body length — among the longest of any animal.
First found in 1952 at a Chinese highway construction site.
